functions.description: Extract JSON fields from Corelight/Zeek SNMP log line
Pull dotted Zeek conn-tuple fields (id.orig_h/p, id.resp_h/p) directly from _raw since they are not valid JS identifiers after JSON extraction
Normalize timestamp, protocol, ports, message and user fields
Classify SNMP activity into action and severity based on notes, auth status and request patterns

add.name: action
add.value: notes && notes.match(/scan/) ? 'reconnaissance' : notes && notes.match(/brute-force/) ? 'credential_attack' : notes && notes.match(/flood|DoS/) ? 'dos_attempt' : auth_failed === true ? 'auth_failure' : set_requests > 0 ? 'config_change' : display_string && display_string.match(/trap/) ? 'trap_received' : get_bulk_requests > 0 ? 'bulk_query' : 'query'

add.name: severity
add.value: notes && notes.match(/scan|brute-force|flood|DoS/) ? 'high' : auth_failed === true ? 'high' : set_requests > 0 ? 'medium' : display_string && display_string.match(/trap/) ? 'medium' : 'low'
